dossier_meta.statement_text: For which subsets $K \subset E^n$ does every red/blue-coloring of $E^n$ contain a red pair of points of distance one or a blue isometric copy of $K$?
dossier_meta.context_text: This is the central question studied throughout the paper. The notation $E^n \to (\ell_2, K)$ means every red/blue-coloring of $E^n$ contains a red copy of $\ell_2$ or a blue copy of $K$, and $E^n \not\to (\ell_2, K)$ means there is a coloring avoiding both. The paper says it follows Erdős et al. [4] in studying this question.
